direction_1_existing_distilled_checkpoin.finding: No pre-trained 1-step/2-step distilled checkpoint supporting Vietnamese zero-shot voice cloning currently exists in open-source repositories.

direction_2_custom_distillation.teacher_model: OmniVoice V2.1 (4-step Flow Matching ODE, Qwen3 28 layers)
direction_2_custom_distillation.distillation_protocol: Progressive Distillation (Salimans & Ho) or Flow Matching Consistency Distillation (4 steps -> 2 steps -> 1 step)
direction_2_custom_distillation.dataset_requirement: 100-300 hours paired Vietnamese audio-text (Vivos, viVoice, VLSP)
direction_2_custom_distillation.compute_requirement: 1x to 4x NVIDIA RTX 4090 / A100 (50-100 GPU hours)
direction_2_custom_distillation.local_training_on_ryzen_3450u: IMPOSSIBLE (Requires gradient backprop through 28 Transformer layers)
direction_2_custom_distillation.projected_cpu_speedup_if_distilled: 2.0x (2-step student) to 3.8x (1-step student), bringing CPU RTF from 4.4x to ~1.2x - 2.2x

test_dimensions: Short sentences (<40 chars) - basic tone clarity
Medium sentences (80-120 chars) - flow and punctuation pauses
Long paragraphs (90s target, ~600-800 chars) - identity stability
6 Tones verification (ngang, huyen, sac, hoi, nga, nang)
Terminal consonants (c, ch, p, t, m, n, ng, nh)
Loanwords and modern terms (AI, GPU, Transformer, CPU)
